title: Serre regularity in codimension ascends along flat maps with regular fibres
statement: Let $\varphi:R\to S$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings, let $k\ge0$, and say that a Noetherian ring $A$ has property $(R_k)$ when $A_{\mathfrak a}$ is a regular local ring for every prime ideal $\mathfrak a$ of height at most $k$. Assume that $R$ and $S$ are Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], that $\varphi$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], that every fibre $S\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ has property $(R_k)$, and that $R$ has property $(R_k)$. Then $S$ has property $(R_k)$. Regular local rings and the residue-field fibres are as in [def-weil-regular-scheme] and [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime].
